product.olivetti-m34.summary: The M30 successor kept the case and sped up the processor.
product.olivetti-m34.history: L’Unità documented the M34 and M44 in June 1985. The M34 continued the M30 desktop line with the same case and MOS compatibility.
product.olivetti-m34.architecture: Diagnostics and initial loading lived on the CPU board. The UC048/A carried two EPROMs, a Z8010B MMU and an MC6850 for RS-232.
product.olivetti-m34.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m34.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
